title: PUT or DELETE /push/live-activity-start response
description: Revision 10. The push-to-start token kept (PUT) or forgotten (DELETE): 204 No Content, empty body. Described here as {status, body} because there is no JSON to describe. Refusals (error.schema.json): 400 bad_request, 422 bad_token, bad_environment. An older server answers 404: it cannot start an activity, and the phone carries on without.

body.description: Nothing: do not parse it as JSON.
